Exercise: Suspended Row

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- horizontal_pulling

Primary Muscles:

- middle back

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- lats

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate to high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- enhancing_posterior_chain_activation
- improving_muscular_endurance
- developing_upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Severe back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Arm Suspended Row, force: pull, level: beginner
- name: Kneeling Suspended Row, force: pull, level: beginner

Substitution Options:

- name: Lat Pulldown, force: pull, level: beginner
- name: Pull-Up, force: pull, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Suspend your straps at around chest height. Take a handle in each hand and lean back. Keep your body erect and your head and chest up. Your arms should be fully extended. This will be your starting position.
- Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement. Protract your shoulder blades as you do so.
- At the completion of the motion pause, and then return to the starting position.
